meta.purpose: Declared truth for the SIL (Software-In-the-Loop) layer: which firmware modules run on the host inside a simulated main loop, and which SIL suites cover them. run-sil-tests.ps1 builds one runner per project from here. SIL is the middle layer of the test pyramid: unit tests (harness/tests/host) assert single return values, SIL asserts properties of TIME SERIES, HIL (harness/tools/dss) asserts the same properties on real silicon.
meta.differs_from_host_tests: A host unit test calls svpwm_modulate() once and checks the struct. A SIL test advances the angle generator 20 times and asserts the resulting waveform keeps a+b+c centred and the phase differences balanced for the whole revolution. Properties that only exist across a sequence of ticks live here, not there.
